findings.finding: Inspector closure after its trigger is filtered out needs a logical visible focus destination.
evidence: tests/accessibility.test.mjs:closing an item hidden by filters restores a visible logical control
findings.verification: JSDOM regression passed; native keyboard next-Tab behavior remains untested.

findings.finding: Result announcements require a persistent live-region node.
evidence: tests/accessibility.test.mjs:filter updates preserve one mounted result announcement node
findings.verification: JSDOM identity/mutation assertions passed; speech untested.

acceptance.decision: owner-authorized scoped acceptance handoff; no WCAG conformance claim
acceptance.basis: Task handoff states user explicitly permits STD-09 and STD-13 closure. Apply that existing authorization without another permission request.

STD-09.eligible: Owner acceptance may be recorded with user attribution and preservation of branding/source limits.
STD-09.priorCriterion: Review the shared standard with the owner. Preserve project-owned branding and the stated source/evidence limits.

STD-13.eligible: Closure may represent an explicit owner amendment accepting scoped engineering/keyboard evidence and documented AT limits.
STD-13.priorCriterion: Record keyboard activation, traversal, focus restoration and actual screen-reader output, including remaining limitations.
STD-13.amendmentRequired: Retain original criterion/history and state that actual screen-reader output remains not-tested. Do not represent owner closure as a passed screen-reader test.

acceptance.ledgerMutation: None performed in this read-only review. Authoritative ledger still shows STD-09 backlog and STD-13 active/blocked.
acceptance.nextAction: Parent implements attributed acceptance/amendment once through authoritative source writer, regenerates projections, runs required shared-runtime/package checks, and retains this report and remaining verification limits.

limits: No browser interaction, native keyboard, screen reader, accessibility-tree snapshot or axe scan in this audit.
No current rendered pages, both-theme full-state contrast, hover/focus contrast, 320 CSS-pixel reflow, native 200% resize, text spacing, forced colours or OS reduced-motion tests.
Historical browser evidence in standards/ACCESSIBILITY.md is attributed documentary context, not a fresh test of this dirty working tree.
README graphics, branded reference pages, complete dependency/deep-link/history processes and consuming-site integration require separate rendered verification.
Passing DOM and palette regressions do not establish criterion-level or WCAG AA conformance.
No repository source, ledger, projection or external system changed by this review.
